chunks: "The time of Maghrib begins when the disk disappears."

key_terms.إِذَا: when; indicating the condition for the ruling
key_terms.الْمَغْرِبِ: the Maghrib prayer, the evening salat
key_terms.غَابَ: disappeared or went out of sight
key_terms.وَقْتُ: the appointed time or beginning time of an act

ai.seo_question: When does the time for Maghrib prayer begin according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for the beginning of the time of Maghrib prayer. It states that Maghrib starts when the disk of the sun disappears below the horizon.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.655 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:
"The time for Maghrib (evening prayer) begins when the disk of the sun disappears."
